tasks.title: 实现 Kernel Delivery Terminal Authority
tasks.scope: 把 Merge 后完成权延长为 Merge→Staging E2E→Production promote/attestation→Final Report/Learning→parent Complete 的单一可回放 delivery 状态机；SKIP/FAIL/sha mismatch/report failure 均 fail-closed；Promote API 加 approver auth；customer confirm 需签名 attestation 后才 promoted；全链 append-only/idempotent。
dod: [BEHAVIOR] Merge 后 parent 进入 delivery/staging_pending 且 staging child 绑定 merge manifest
[BEHAVIOR] staging SKIP(no_contract) 不得 success 且 parent 保持 blocked
[BEHAVIOR] tested_sha 缺失或不等于 merged_sha 必须 fail-closed
[BEHAVIOR] Internal production health/fingerprint/E2E 失败进入 rollback_required 且带 rollback anchor
[BEHAVIOR] customer confirm 无签名 attestation 不得 promoted
[BEHAVIOR] final report persisted 前 parent 不得 completed; persisted 后 atomically complete
[BEHAVIOR] 重放同一 staging/promote/report 事件不重复
[ARTIFACT] 新增 delivery authority 模块、migration、route wiring 与回归测试
